effect.name: Bloom
effect.description: Bright pixels bleed light into their neighbours. One pass, two rings of taps - not a film-grade bloom, but it costs one draw and it makes lamps, coins and explosions feel hot.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Glow Colour
parameter.description: Colour the glow is pushed toward when Tint Strength is above 0.

parameter.name: Threshold
parameter.description: Only pixels brighter than this bleed.

parameter.name: Intensity
parameter.description: How much light is added back.

parameter.name: Radius
parameter.description: How far the light spreads, in texels.

parameter.name: Tint Strength
parameter.description: Pushes the glow toward Glow Colour instead of the colour of the pixel that made it.
